messages.subject: missing legend
parts:
Dear ggplotters,

I am trying to realize plots with a legend explaining all 8 lines plotted in each sector of the plotting area:
I have 4 variables (Variable, Type, Year, and the value Moran.I) and I want all Type(=1:8) plotted in the same plot. Somehow the legend does not appear.

Any help on the issue is very much appreciated!

Ale

# Factor definition
MoranI$layer1 <- factor(MoranI$Type)

p <- ggplot(MoranI, aes(Year,Moran.I))

p <- p + geom_point(data=MoranI[which(MoranI$Type=="1"),],colour = "red",linetype=1, size = 1) +
geom_line(data=MoranI[which(MoranI$Type=="2"),],colour = "red",linetype=2, size = 1) +
geom_line(data=MoranI[which(MoranI$Type=="3"),],colour = "black",linetype=1, size = 1) +
geom_line(data=MoranI[which(MoranI$Type=="4"),],colour = "black",linetype=2, size = 1) +
geom_line(data=MoranI[which(MoranI$Type=="5"),],colour = "black",linetype=3, size = 1) +
geom_line(data=MoranI[which(MoranI$Type=="6"),],colour = "blue", linetype=1, size = 1) +
geom_line(data=MoranI[which(MoranI$Type=="7"),],colour = "blue", linetype=2, size = 1) +
geom_line(data=MoranI[which(MoranI$Type=="8"),],colour = "blue",linetype=3, size = 1) +
labs(title = "Moran's I",
x = "", y = "") +
scale_fill_manual(values=c("red", "red", "black", "black", "black", "blue", "blue", "blue"),
labels=c("First Order Queen", "Rook", "20km","50km","100km","5 Nearest Neigh.","10 Nearest Neigh.","15 Nearest Neigh.")) +
facet_wrap(~ layer2)
p

parts:
Alessandra, if you can post a sample data set, people will be able to
give you a complete solution, but basically: you're going about this
wrong. You want to do something like

p <- ggplot(MoranI, aes(Year,Moran.I,color=Type)) +
geom_line()+scale_fill_manual(...) + facet_wrap(~layer2)

rather than have all those different geom_line calls on subsetted data.

Ben
